topic: UI issues on inventory management screen
summary_markdown: The discussion focused on several UI/UX issues. One issue noted was an empty row appearing in the data display. A more significant issue raised concerned the inventory management screen, where edit buttons are not visible unless the browser is zoomed out. This prevents users from seeing or utilizing the core edit functionality.
decisions: p1 provided login credentials to p2 for testing.
action_items: p2 will check the empty row issue and investigate the UI problem with invisible edit buttons on the inventory management screen.
